dogecoin.text: We think #Dogecoin is awesome which is why we are integrating it with Flare so that it can be trustlessly used with smart contracts. #UnleashingValue

$FLR is natively used in the Flare Time Series Oracle for which rewards in $FLR are earned. $FLR is also used as collateral to mint F-Assets (FDoge etc) onto Flare. For this use the user earns rewards in the native asset. E.g #dogecoin, #XRP, #LTC etc. #UnleashingValue
On Flare you earn $FLR for minting and using your assets (such as #dogecoin, #XRP, #XLM and so on) on to Flare. #UnleashingValue
Each network integrated with Flare contributes to Flare’s consensus and decentralisation. https://t.co/Cef9csTnqa #dogecoin #XLM #LTC #XRP #UnleashingValue

Flare is integrating #dogecoin for network launch. #dogecoin can be trustlessly used in smart contracts on Flare together with #XRP, #XLM and #LTC. More networks can be added. Each network contributes to Flare’s consensus. #UnleashingValue
